issues.description: Status inconsistency: notes.md '编译环境' section claims '状态: published' while manifest.yaml declares 'status: built' and notes.md's own '最终状态' also says 'built'. 'Published' indicates CI upload succeeded; if the package is only built (not uploaded), this is a misleading status claim.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change '状态: published' to '状态: built' in notes.md to match manifest.yaml and the notes' own final status.

issues.description: Manual mirror URL prefixes (gh-proxy, mirror.ghproxy, ghproxy, gitclone, moeyy, kkgithub) are included in the URL list. R39 states CI auto-adds mirror fallback, so conandata.yml should only contain the official GitHub URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove all mirror-prefixed URLs, keep only the official URL: "https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/archive/refs/tags/v0.25.12.tar.gz"

issues.description: os.environ is used directly in build() to set CGO_ENABLED, GOPROXY, GOSUMDB, GOCACHE, and GOTMPDIR. R33 prohibits bare use of shell environment variables. While all values are explicitly set (no silent failure risk), using global os.environ has side effects on other build steps.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use self.run() with scoped env parameter instead of modifying global os.environ. Example: self.run('go build ...', env={'CGO_ENABLED': '0', 'GOPROXY': ..., ...})

issues.description: url = "" is an empty placeholder. Code style rule 5 lists 'url = ""  # CI fills this' as a template placeholder indicating incomplete work.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the recipe repository URL, or remove the url attribute if not applicable.

issues.description: package_type is not set. Code style rule 2 requires package_type for tools to be "application". esbuild is a CLI tool.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add package_type = "application" after the settings attribute.

issues.description: import subprocess is unused — no subprocess calls appear in the recipe.
Shell script does not start with 'set -euo pipefail'. Code style rule 7 requires all scripts to use safe mode.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add 'set -euo pipefail' after the shebang line.

issues.description: Shebang is #!/bin/sh instead of #!/usr/bin/zsh per code style rule 6.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change shebang to #!/usr/bin/zsh, or keep #!/bin/sh if POSIX compatibility is intentionally required.

issues.description: Output format uses 'PASS:'/'FAIL:' instead of [ok]/[fail] format specified in code style rule 9.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use 'echo "        [ok] esbuild smoke test passed"' and 'echo "        [fail] esbuild did not produce output file"' format.

issues.description: Field name 'software:' used instead of 'name:' per code style rule 14 manifest.yaml format.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change 'software: esbuild' to 'name: esbuild' to match the standard manifest format.

issues.description: settings = "os", "arch" omits "compiler" and "build_type". While acceptable for a pure Go build (no C/C++ compiler needed), standard settings include all four.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding "compiler" and "build_type" to settings if future C/C++ dependencies are anticipated.

issues.description: build_system: custom is not in the standard list (cmake | autotools | makefile | meson). While appropriate for Go builds, it may need to be added to the standard list.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider registering 'custom' as a valid build_system value in the code style rules, or use 'makefile' if applicable.

summary: Audit passed after fixing P1 (status consistency) and P2 issues (unused import, url placeholder, package_type). P0 deception checks all passed.
